PhD position in Crop Phenotyping (PhenoMix project) 100%, Zurich, fixed-term print Drucken This doctoral student position is part of the project “ PhenoMix: Multidimensional field phenotyping of crop mixtures ”, supported by the Swiss National Science Foundation. The position is hosted by the Crop Science group ; a vibrant and interdisciplinary working group in the Institute of Agricultural Sciences at the Department of Environmental Systems Science at ETH Zurich. Our group’s phenotyping research focuses on the development of methods and models to determine traits of relevance for crop breeding and variety testing. Project background PhenoMix is a joint project of four research groups at ETH Zurich, the Swiss Data Science Center and Agroscope. The overall objective of PhenoMix is to test the hypothesis that current high throughput field phenotyping (HTFP) technology in combination with plant physiological assessments and data science can provide a breakthrough to determine genotypes that can be successfully combined in agroecologically beneficial legume-cereal mixtures. Different varieties of pea and lentil as well as wheat, oats and barley will be grown under our field phenotyping platform FIP ( FIP – Crop Science | ETH Zurich ), on a neighbouring experimental field and on farmer’s fields. PhenoMix Work Packages address phenotyping, plant ecophysiology, data science, and agro-economic assessments with four doctoral students, two postdocs and several technicians assigned to those work packages. The Crop Phenotyping doctoral student will contribute to collecting HTFP data, improving phenotyping workflows and developing a field robot for lean phenotyping. Job description This doctoral project will form an important cornerstone in the mosaic of the entire project with specific tasks depending on skills, interests and alignment with at least two postdoctoral projects for which recruiting is also going on currently. Overall tasks of the project include:
• Collection of HTFP data from various phenotyping devices such as the FIP (multi-view RGB imaging), drones, handheld and manual devices
• Contribution to the design and/or establishment of a phenotyping robot that can acquire data from RGB cameras and potentially other sensors
• Improving phenotyping workflows and models to extract traits such as canopy height, canopy cover, tillering, reflectance, senescence or growth dynamics from this data
• Performing statistical analyses, including AI-based approaches
• Presentation of results at national and international events and publication in peer-reviewed journals
• Assistance in plot establishment, maintenance, and harvest across all Work Packages of PhenoMix. Profile
• A Master’s degree in agricultural, data or engineering sciences, or a closely related field
• Experience with fieldwork
• Good statistical skills
• Programming experience (e.g. in R or Python)
• Good standard of written and spoken English
• Good writing skills
• Driver’s license
• Ability to work in a team with an interdisciplinary background
• Experience in crop phenotyping and good oral communication skills in German are beneficial Workplace Workplace We offer

Postdoc position in Phenotyping of Crop Mixtures (PhenoMix project) 100%, Zurich, fixed-term print Drucken This postdoctoral position is part of the project “ PhenoMix: Multidimensional field phenotyping of crop mixtures ”, supported by the Swiss National Science Foundation. This position is hosted by the Crop Science group ; a vibrant and interdisciplinary working group in the Institute of Agricultural Sciences at the Department of Environmental Systems Science at ETH Zurich. Our group’s phenotyping research focuses on the development of methods and models to determine traits of relevance for crop breeding and variety testing. Project background PhenoMix is a joint project of four research groups at ETH Zurich, the Swiss Data Science Center and Agroscope. The overall objective of PhenoMix is to test the hypothesis that current high throughput field phenotyping (HTFP) technology in combination with plant physiological assessments and data science can provide a breakthrough to determine genotypes that can be successfully combined in agroecologically beneficial legume-cereal mixtures. Different varieties of pea and lentil as well as wheat, oats and barley will be grown under our field phenotyping platform FIP , on a neighbouring experimental field and on farmer’s fields. PhenoMix Work Packages address phenotyping, plant ecophysiology, data science, and agro-economic assessments with four doctoral students, two postdocs and several technicians assigned to those work packages. The postdoc for Phenotyping of Crop Mixtures will coordinate several overarching activities in the PhenoMix project and will contribute to collecting HTFP data, improving phenotyping workflows and developing a field robot for lean phenotyping. Job description This postdoctoral position will form an important cornerstone in the mosaic of the entire project with specific tasks depending on skills, interests and alignment with at least one other postdoctoral position on data science and a doctoral student on Crop Phenotyping within the Crop Science group, for which recruiting is also going on currently. Overall tasks of this project include:
• Co-design and coordinate field experiments and workplan for HTFP data collection
• Contribute to field work and to the collection of HTFP data from various phenotyping devices such as the FIP (multi-view RGB imaging), drones, handheld and manual devices
• Contribute to the design and/or establishment of a phenotyping robot that can acquire data from RGB cameras and potentially other sensors
• Generate modelling approaches to predict optimal cereal-legume combinations
• Supervise and mentor students from BSc to PhD-level
• Assist in the delivery of lectures or seminars for the Crop Science group
• Publish results in peer-reviewed journals; present at national and international conferences
• Contribute to international research networks and apply for funding
• The initial contract duration is two years with the possibility of extension to the full lifetime of this four-year-project, based on satisfactory performance
• Salary and social benefits are provided according to ETH Zurich rules Profile
• A PhD in agricultural sciences or a related field
• Several years of research experience in field crop phenotyping
• Good statistical and programming skills (e.g. in R or Python)
• Evidence of research excellence through peer-reviewed publications
• A strong desire for teaching, mentoring, teamwork and team coordination
• Driver’s license
• Good oral communication skills in German are highly beneficial Workplace Workplace We offer
• Your job with impact: Become part of ETH Zurich, which not only supports your professional development, but also actively contributes to positive change in society
• You can expect numerous benefits , such as public transport season tickets and car sharing, a wide range of sports offered by the ASVZ , childcare and attractive pension benefits

chevron left Übersicht chevron left Übersicht Position Postdoc dans Phénotypage des mélanges de cultures (projet PhenoMix) 100%, Zurich, tirage à terme fixe Drucken Ce poste postdoctoral fait partie du projet PhénoMix: Phénotypage multidimensionnel sur le terrain des mélanges de cultures, soutenu par la Fondation nationale suisse des sciences. Ce poste est hébergé par le groupe Crop Science ; un groupe de travail dynamique et interdisciplinaire à l'Institut des sciences agricoles au Département des sciences des systèmes environnementaux à l'ETH Zurich. Notre recherche de phénotypage de groupe se concentre sur l'élaboration de méthodes et de modèles pour déterminer les caractéristiques pertinentes pour la sélection des cultures et l'analyse des variétés. Contexte du projet PhenoMix est un projet conjoint de quatre groupes de recherche à l'ETH Zurich, au Centre suisse des données scientifiques et à l'Agroscope. L'objectif global de PhenoMix est de tester l'hypothèse selon laquelle la technologie actuelle de phénotypage en champ à haut débit, combinée à des évaluations physiologiques des plantes et à la science des données, peut fournir une percée pour déterminer les génotypes qui peuvent être combinés avec succès dans des mélanges agroécologiquement bénéfiques légumineuses-céréales. Différentes variétés de pois et de lentilles ainsi que du blé, de l'avoine et de l'orge seront cultivées sous notre plate-forme de phénotypage FIP, sur un champ expérimental voisin et sur des champs fermiers. Les trousses de travail PhénoMix traitent du phénotypage, de l'écophysiologie des plantes, de la science des données et des évaluations agro-économiques avec quatre doctorants, deux postdoctorants et plusieurs techniciens affectés à ces trousses de travail. Le postdoc pour le phénotypage des mélanges de cultures coordonnera plusieurs activités globales dans le projet PhénoMix et contribuera à la collecte des données du PFTE, à l'amélioration des flux de travail du phénotypage et au développement d'un robot de terrain pour le phénotypage maigre. Description du poste Ce poste postdoctoral constituera une pierre angulaire importante dans la mosaïque de l'ensemble du projet avec des tâches spécifiques en fonction des compétences, des intérêts et de l'alignement avec au moins un autre poste postdoctoral en science des données et un étudiant au doctorat en Phénotypage des cultures au sein du groupe Crop Science, pour lequel le recrutement est également en cours. Les tâches générales de ce projet sont les suivantes :
• Co-concevoir et coordonner des expériences sur le terrain et un plan de travail pour la collecte de données sur le PFTE
• Contribuer au travail sur le terrain et à la collecte de données sur le PFTE à partir de divers appareils de phénotypage tels que le FIP (imagerie RGB à vision multiple), les drones, les appareils portatifs et manuels
• Contribuer à la conception et/ou à la création d'un robot de phénotypage capable d'acquérir des données à partir de caméras RGB et d'autres capteurs potentiels
• Générer des approches de modélisation pour prédire des combinaisons optimales céréales-légumes
• Superviser et mentorer les étudiants du BSc au niveau du doctorat
• Aider à la prestation de conférences ou de séminaires pour le groupe Crop Science
• Publier les résultats dans des revues évaluées par les pairs; présenter aux conférences nationales et internationales
• Contribuer aux réseaux de recherche internationaux et demander un financement
• La durée initiale du contrat est de deux ans avec la possibilité de prolonger la durée totale de ce projet de quatre ans, sur la base d'une performance satisfaisante
• Les salaires et avantages sociaux sont fournis selon les règles de l'ETH Zurich Profil

• Plusieurs années d'expérience en recherche sur le phénotypage des cultures de champ
• Bonnes compétences en statistique et en programmation (par exemple en R ou Python)
• Preuve d'excellence en recherche grâce à des publications évaluées par des pairs

Postdoctoral Researcher - OCCL 100%, Singapore, fixed-term Drucken The Singapore-ETH Centre was established in 2010 by ETH Zurich - The Swiss Federal Institute of Technology and Singapore’s National Research Foundation (NRF), as part of the NRF’s CREATE campus. As ETH Zurich's only research centre outside of Switzerland, the centre has strengthened the research capacity of ETH Zurich to develop sustainable solutions to global challenges in Switzerland, Singapore and the surrounding regions. Set in Asia, in a rapidly urbanising region, the Singapore-ETH Centre aims to provide practical solutions to some of the most pressing challenges on urban sustainability, resilience and health through its programmes: Future Cities Lab Global (FCL Global) and Future Health Technologies (FHT) . The centre serves as an intellectual hub for research, bringing together principal investigators and researchers from diverse disciplines and backgrounds. To promote the exchange of ideas and expertise, our researchers actively collaborate with universities and research institutes and engage with industry and government agencies to translate knowledge to practical solutions to real-world problems. Project background The current era of artificial intelligence is predominantly driven by advances in computational power and infrastructure. As models scale to unprecedented sizes, their capabilities are enhanced through strategies such as reinforcement learning (RL) and innovative frameworks like the "graph of thoughts". We are firmly in the "Age of Computation", where breakthroughs in AI are synonymous with the ability to harness and optimize massive computational resources. However, this rapid growth in computational demands comes with a critical challenge: energy limitations. Around the globe, new power plants are being constructed to meet the demands of AI workloads, underscoring the urgent need for efficiency to ensure these advancements benefit humanity sustainably. Especially in Singapore, such resources may be scarce and hinder the ability of the country’s researchers to advance in this most important field. Our collaborative efforts with the A*STAR Institute of High Performance Computing (IHPC) and other partners in Singapore, such as NTU, could be pivotal in this field, driving the development and implementation of innovative AI methods and saving millions of dollars in compute time while accelerating scientific productivity . To enhance the efficacy of AI for Science models, it is imperative to integrate simulations that encode prior scientific knowledge within these AI frameworks . This integration is aimed at creating new models imbued with robust prior knowledge, such as simulated behaviours defined by fundamental equations and conservation laws. Our approach involves the close collaboration of experts from A*STAR / IHPC, who bring extensive experience in high-performance computing and AI-driven scientific research. Together, we aim to push the boundaries of what AI can achieve in scientific domains, ensuring that simulations and AI methodologies are combined to produce highly accurate and reliable models. Job description The Postdoctoral Researcher will be co-leading the development of a novel open-source accelerator communication library (OCCL). This communication library should support point-to-point as well as collective communication calls. It should allow communication initiated by the host, as well as communication initiated within accelerator device kernels. It should support a wide range of devices and network substrates, such as NVLINK and next-generation ethernet networks. Some key components in the work are:
• Co-lead the design and development of an open-source accelerator communication library (OCCL) supporting point-to-point and collective communication for distributed AI workloads.
• Design and implement communication primitives and algorithms optimised for machine learning training and inference w

Vuoi essere nel cuore del tempo? Allora siete proprio all'ETH di Zurigo, perché è qui che nasce il futuro. Designazione L'insegnamento ideale per i giovani adulti con entusiasmo per le scienze naturali e i processi chimico-fisici! Lavori in diversi settori di ricerca e sviluppo:
• Pianificare e condurre esperimenti per produrre nuovi composti chimici o per rispondere a domande analitiche
• Produrre, pulire e controllare la purezza chimica di principi attivi e prodotti
• Utilizzo della ricerca e dello sviluppo di sostanze attive e sostanze chimiche
• Utilizzazione di apparecchi di vetro e tecnologia di laboratorio e metodi di misura assistiti da computer La formazione dura 3 anni, di cui 6 mesi di formazione di base nel nostro laboratorio di insegnamento sul campus ETH Hönggerberg. Durante il periodo di insegnamento, si modifica il luogo di utilizzo secondo il principio di rotazione e conoscere l'ETE da angoli diversi. Profilo Ti piace sperimentare e interessarti in chimica, fisica e matematica, oltre a lavorare con dispositivi elettronici e apparati complessi. Inoltre, si dispone di una buona osservazione, abilità di ingegneria fine, sono affidabili e hanno uno stile di lavoro attento, strutturato e preciso. • matematica
• Biologia

Laborant:in EFZ (m/w/d) 2026 - Chemistry Zürich, Lehrstelle Print You want to do a sustainable teaching? You are curious, open-minded, want to move and grow personally? You want to be at the heart of time? Then you are right at ETH Zurich, because this is where the future is created. Description The ideal teaching for young adults with enthusiasm for natural sciences and chemical-physical processes! You work in different areas of research and development:
• Planning and conducting experiments to produce new chemical compounds or to answer analytical questions
• Produce, clean and check the chemical purity of active ingredients and products
• Using the research and development of active substances and chemical substances
• Use of glass apparatus and laboratory technology and computer-assisted measurement methods The training lasts 3 years, of which 6 months basic training in our teaching laboratory on the ETH Campus Hönggerberg. During the teaching period, you change the place of use according to the rotation principle and get to know the ETH from different angles. PhD Researcher - AI TokCart 100%, Singapore, fixed-term Drucken The Singapore-ETH Centre was established in 2010 by ETH Zurich - The Swiss Federal Institute of Technology and Singapore’s National Research Foundation (NRF) , as part of the NRF’s CREATE campus. As ETH Zurich's only research centre outside of Switzerland, the centre has strengthened the research capacity of ETH Zurich to develop sustainable solutions to global challenges in Switzerland, Singapore and the surrounding regions. Set in Asia, in a rapidly urbanising region, the Singapore-ETH Centre aims to provide practical solutions to some of the most pressing challenges on urban sustainability, resilience and health through its programmes: Future Cities Lab Global (FCL Global) and Future Health Technologies (FHT) . The centre serves as an intellectual hub for research, bringing together principal investigators and researchers from diverse disciplines and backgrounds. To promote the exchange of ideas and expertise, our researchers actively collaborate with universities and research institutes and engage with industry and government agencies to translate knowledge to practical solutions to real-world problems. Project background The healthcare systems of the future must harness data effectively to support clinicians, allowing them to focus on patient care while leveraging AIto detect patterns beyond human perception, enhance diagnostic accuracy, optimise workflows, improve risk assessment and communication. Developing AI models that address these needs is particularly urgent in ageing societies, where rising patient numbers coincide with increasing workforce constraints. A major contributor to disability in older adults is impaired musculoskeletal (MSK) health, with fall-related fractures representing a central research focus for our group. Despite their substantial socioeconomic burden, progress in prevention and screening has been limited, partly because fall and fracture risks are often addressed independently, despite their shared underlying mechanisms. A promising direction for AI in healthcare is the seamless integration of clinical image-based foundation models that can be fine-tuned across multiple use cases. In this project, we aim to develop cross-modal AI models for MSK health evaluation by linking diverse clinical imaging datasets. The central innovation is the creation of a shared, tokenized latent space that enables data translation, risk modelling, and local deployment, even in settings with limited imaging data. Particular emphasis will be placed on integrating advanced biomechanical markers of bone health into AI workflows, supporting more precise and clinically actionable risk assessment. Job description The PhD candidate will be embedded into a team of researchers that is working on developing large medical image-based AI models for managing MSK health. Some key components in the work are:
• Pretraining, adapting, and evaluating foundation models for medical image data using self-supervised and multimodal representation learning.
• Developing cross-modal image modelling methods, including cross-modal translation, multimodal fusion, and related generative or representation-learning approaches.
• Evaluating the learned models on clinically relevant downstream tasks, such as bone health assessment, anatomical and biomechanical biomarker estimation, and fracture-risk-related prediction.
• Co-supervision of MSc and BSc students. Please note that the employment will be at the Singapore-ETH Centre in Singapore, and local working regulations will apply. Funding is provided for up to four years. After successful completion of studies, the PhD degree will be awarded by ETH Zurich. Profile
• Applicants should hold an MSc degree and have a strong background in computer science, engineering, mathematics, physics, or a related quantitative discipline.
• Candidates should be capable of working largely independently on complex rese

Descrizione Avviso legale (m/w/d) 80%-100%, Zurigo, illimitato ETH Zurich è sinonimo di insegnamento eccellente, ricerca di base innovativa e l'applicazione dei risultati a beneficio della società. Fondata nel 1855, è ora una delle migliori università scientifiche e tecniche del mondo. Il servizio legale dell'ETH di Zurigo fa parte del Segretariato generale dell'ETH di Zurigo, che viene assegnato alla direzione scolastica con i compiti di un ufficio generale del personale. Per rafforzare il nostro team, stiamo cercando un Legal Counsel con un focus sulla protezione dei dati e sul principio della pubblicità. Designazione Le aree di protezione e pubblicità dei dati stanno diventando sempre più importanti a Zurigo. A causa dei requisiti nazionali e internazionali in materia di protezione dei dati, i progetti di ricerca nel campo della medicina umana, dell'analisi dei dati e dell'intelligenza artificiale, nonché i progetti di digitalizzazione nell'amministrazione stanno affrontando sfide crescenti a Zurigo. Inoltre, il principio pubblico si è stabilito nell'amministrazione federale e il grande interesse del pubblico nell'ETH Zurigo porta ad aumentare il numero di richieste basate sul diritto pubblico. Pertanto, stiamo cercando una persona resiliente con un modo di lavorare molto pragmatico, che ha esperienze nella protezione dei dati e idealmente con le leggi dell'informazione/pubblicazione e vuole approfondire questo in stretta collaborazione con i responsabili della protezione dei dati dell'ETH Zurigo e della politica pubblica. Allo stesso tempo, una persona adatta dovrebbe essere interessato alle diverse questioni legali di un'università leader. Il suo compito versatile comprende quindi, tra l'altro, l'esame e la scrittura di contratti, regolamenti, istruzioni, ordini, regolamenti legali e regole di procedura e la consulenza su vari temi di governance e conformità. Ci aspettiamo di ricordare rapidamente i complessi contesti organizzativi di un'università. Essi affrontano argomenti proattivamente e agiscono orientati alla soluzione. Sono caratterizzati da competenze di negoziazione, alta competenza sociale e capacità di comunicazione pronunciate. Al vostro lavoro avete sempre uno sguardo agli interessi dell'organizzazione generale. Profilo - Studi legali completi e brevetti legali (CH, DE o AT) - Esperienza professionale pluriennale nell'amministrazione pubblica e/o nel settore privato con particolare attenzione alla protezione dei dati e al diritto dell'informazione - Buona conoscenza del diritto amministrativo federale, diritto amministrativo procedurale (VwVG) e diritto contrattuale generale - Piacere alle attività operative, coordinate e consultive - la volontà di supervisionare i casi al di fuori della protezione dei dati e del diritto dell'informazione e di lavorare in nuovi settori - Capacità di pensare rapidamente in complesse relazioni organizzative, trovare soluzioni pratiche in modo efficiente e guardare oltre il bordo della piastra - Interessi in materia di affari e sfaccettamento per contesti accademici e politici - Soluzione e pensiero e azione orientati al cliente, capacità di comunicazione orientate agli indirizzi, capacità di negoziazione, resilienza - Ottima conoscenza del tedesco, comunicazione esperta in inglese e ottime competenze francesi Luogo di lavoro Luogo di lavoro
• Offriamo - Un team consolidato che lavora in modo stretto e costruttivo: Siamo una squadra – e questo è importante per noi! - Attività versatili e responsabili con approfondimenti su argomenti di alta tensione - Un ambiente di lavoro stimolante

Descrizione Legal Counsel (m/w/d) 80%-100%, Zurich, unlimited ETH Zurich stands for excellent teaching, groundbreaking basic research and the application of the results for the benefit of society. Founded in 1855, it is now one of the world's best scientific and technical universities. The legal service of ETH Zurich is part of the General Secretariat of ETH Zurich, which is assigned to the school management with the tasks of a general staff office. To strengthen our team, we are looking for a Legal Counsel with a focus on data protection and the principle of publicity. Description The areas of data protection and publicity are becoming increasingly important at ETH Zurich. Due to national and international data protection requirements, research projects in the fields of human medicine, data analysis and artificial intelligence as well as digitization projects in the administration are facing growing challenges at ETH Zurich. In addition, the public principle has established itself in the federal administration and the great interest of the public in ETH Zurich leads to increasing numbers of requests based on the public law. Therefore, we are looking for a resilient person with a very pragmatic way of working, who has experiences in data protection and ideally with information/publicity laws and wants to deepen this in close cooperation with ETH Zurich's data protection and public policy officers. At the same time, a suitable person should be interested in the diverse further legal issues of a leading university. Its versatile task therefore includes, among other things, the examination and writing of contracts, regulations, instructions, orders, legal regulations and rules of procedure and the advice on various governance and compliance issues. We expect you to quickly remember the complex organizational contexts of a university. They address topics proactively and act solution-oriented. They are characterized by negotiation skills, high social competence and pronounced communication skills. At your work you always have a look at the interests of the overall organisation.
• Profile - Completed legal studies and legal patent (CH, DE or AT) - Multiannual professional experience in public administration and/or the private sector with a focus on data protection and information law - Good knowledge of federal administrative law, administrative procedural law (VwVG) and general contract law - Pleasure to operational, coordinating and advisory activities - willingness to supervise cases outside data protection and information law and to work into new areas - Ability to think quickly into complex organizational relationships, find practical solutions efficiently and look beyond the plate edge - Interest in business topics and flair for academic and political contexts - Solution and customer-oriented thinking and action, address-oriented communication skills, negotiation skills, resilience - Excellent knowledge of German, experienced communication in English and ideally good French skills Place of employment Place of employment
• We offer - A well-established team working closely and constructively: We are a team – and that is important to us! - Versatile and responsible activities with insight into high-voltage, topical topics - An inspiring working environment

Stellenbeschreibung Die Bereiche Datenschutz und Öffentlichkeitsprinzip gewinnen an der ETH Zürich immer mehr an Bedeutung. Aufgrund nationaler und internationaler datenschutzrechtlicher Vorgaben stehen an der ETH Zürich sowohl Forschungsprojekte insbesondere in den Bereichen Humanmedizin, Datenanalyse und künstliche Intelligenz als auch Digitalisierungsvorhaben in der Verwaltung vor wachsenden Herausforderungen. Daneben hat sich das Öffentlichkeitsprinzip in der Bundesverwaltung etabliert und das grosse Interesse der Öffentlichkeit an der ETH Zürich führt zu zunehmend steigenden Zahlen an Gesuchen, die auf das Öffentlichkeitsgesetz gestützt werden. Für diese Stelle im Rechtsdienst suchen wir deshalb eine belastbare Person mit einer ausgeprägt pragmatischen Arbeitsweise, die Erfahrungen im Datenschutz und idealerweise mit Informations-/Öffentlichkeitsgesetzen aufweist und diese in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Datenschutz- und Öffentlichkeitsprinzip-Beauftragten der ETH Zürich vertiefen will. Gleichzeitig sollte eine geeignete Person interessiert sein an den vielfältigen weiteren rechtlichen Themen einer führenden Hochschule. Ihr vielseitiger Aufgabenbereich umfasst daher u.a. auch die Prüfung und das Verfassen von Verträgen, Verordnungen, Weisungen, Verfügungen, Rechtsschriften und Geschäftsordnungen und die Beratung zu diversen Governance- und Compliance-Themen. Wir erwarten, dass Sie sich rasch in die komplexen organisatorischen Zusammenhänge einer Hochschule eindenken können. Sie gehen Themen proaktiv an und handeln lösungsorientiert. Sie zeichnen sich durch Verhandlungsgeschick, hohe Sozialkompetenz und ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit aus. Bei Ihrer Arbeit haben Sie stets die Interessen der Gesamtorganisation im Blick. Profil

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ricercatore post-dottorato in AI per l'inferenza delle informazioni sul clima

100%, Zurigo, a tempo determinato

stampa
Druppo

Il ricercatore post-dottorato avanzerà l'applicazione di AI, grandi modelli di lingua (LLM), e l'apprendimento automatico per estrarre le informazioni climatiche affidabili dai dataset di sistema geospaziale e terrestre su larga scala, all'interno del programma NCCR CLIM+. Il ruolo collega la scienza del clima e l'intelligenza artificiale, sviluppando nuovi metodi per l'analisi dei dati climatici, il downscaling e la sintesi utilizzando modelli di fondazione (ad esempio Google Earth AI, AlphaEarth, TerraTorch) su una piattaforma HPC all'avanguardia. Il ricercatore condurrà una ricerca scientifica pubblica mentre costruirà strumenti e condotte che servono la più ampia comunità CLIM+. La posizione è supervisionata congiuntamente dal Prof. Andreas Prein, dal Prof. Erich Fischer e dal Prof. Reto Knutti all'ETH di Zurigo e dal Prof. Markus Leippold all'Università di Zurigo.

Sfondo del progetto

La scienza del clima sta generando volumi in rapida crescita di dati satellitari, di rianalisi e di modelli, creando nuove opportunità ma anche grandi sfide per trasformare i dati in informazioni robuste e utili. Questo progetto svilupperà metodi basati su AI per estrarre, sintetizzare e interpretare le informazioni climatiche affidabili dai dataset del sistema terrestre di grandi e complessi all'interno del programma NCCR CLIM+.

Descrizione del lavoro

• Progettare, sviluppare e applicare metodi AI/ML — compresi i modelli di lingua di grandi dimensioni (LLM) e i modelli di fondazione (Google Earth AI, AlphaEarth, TerraTorch) — per estrarre, sintetizzare e ragionare su informazioni climatiche affidabili da geospaziali su larga scala, satelliti, rianalisi e dataset del modello climatico

• Apprendimento avanzato della macchina fisica-consapevole per la rappresentazione del processo climatico su scala di chilometri

• Implementazione e valutazione di modelli AI generativi avanzati per la riduzione del clima ad alta risoluzione, l'assimilazione dei dati, l'emulazione e il post-elaborazione di previsioni meteo-clima

• Sviluppare metodi di quantificazione dell'incertezza nelle proiezioni in calo dei rischi climatici estremi e climatici

• Lavorare con i dati del sistema terrestre multimodale tra cui uscite di modelli climatici satelliti, aerei, in-situ, rianalisi e ad alta risoluzione

• Costruire strumenti software robusti e scalabili e datadotti per il trattamento di grandi dataset geospaziali, consentendo ai partner di progetto CLIM+ e alla più ampia comunità di ricerca di sfruttare le informazioni climatiche basate su AI

• Sviluppare e mantenere flussi di lavoro di ricerca riproducibili utilizzando moderne pratiche di ingegneria del software (controllo di conversione, test, documentazione, containerizzazione)

• Condurre ricerca scientifica originale e pubblica che genera nuove intuizioni all'incrocio di AI e scienza del clima

• Scrivere e presentare giornali peer-reviewed, presenti a conferenze internazionali, e contribuire a NCCR CLIM+ reporting e sovvenzioni proposte

• Assicurarsi che la ricerca produce sia conoscenze scientifiche che contributi metodologici sul campo

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con i gruppi di ricerca di ETH (Prein, Knutti, Fischer) e UZH (Leippold, Vaghefi, Colesanti Senni) per allineare lo sviluppo di AI con le domande di ricerca sulla scienza del clima

• Contribuire alla supervisione di studenti e tirocinanti, se del caso

descriptionByLocale.en:
Postdoctoral Researcher in AI for Climate Information Inference

100%, Zurich, fixed-term

print
Drucken

The postdoctoral researcher will advance the application of AI, large language models (LLMs), and machine learning to extract trustworthy climate information from large-scale geospatial and Earth system datasets, within the NCCR CLIM+ program. The role bridges climate science and AI, developing novel methods for climate data analysis, downscaling, and synthesis using foundation models (e.g., Google Earth AI, AlphaEarth, TerraTorch) on a cutting-edge HPC platform. The researcher will conduct publishable scientific research while building tools and pipelines that serve the broader CLIM+ community. The position is jointly supervised by Prof. Andreas Prein, Prof. Erich Fischer, and Prof. Reto Knutti at ETH Zurich and Prof. Markus Leippold at the University of Zurich.

Project background

Climate science is generating rapidly growing volumes of satellite, reanalysis, and model data, creating new opportunities but also major challenges for turning data into robust and useful information. This project will develop AI-based methods to extract, synthesize, and interpret trustworthy climate information from large and complex Earth system datasets within the NCCR CLIM+ programme.

Job description

• Design, develop, and apply AI/ML methods — including large language models (LLMs) and foundation models (Google Earth AI, AlphaEarth, TerraTorch) — to extract, synthesize, and reason about trustworthy climate information from large-scale geospatial, satellite, reanalysis, and climate model datasets

• Advanced physics-aware machine learning for kilometer-scale climate process representation

• Implement and evaluate advanced generative AI models for high-resolution climate downscaling, data assimilation, emulation, and post-processing of weather-to-climate predictions

• Develop methods for uncertainty quantification in downscaled projections of extreme weather and climate hazards

• Work with multimodal Earth system data including satellite, airborne, in-situ, reanalysis, and high-resolution climate model outputs

• Build robust, scalable software tools and data pipelines for processing large geospatial datasets, enabling CLIM+ project partners and the broader research community to leverage AI-driven climate information

• Develop and maintain reproducible research workflows using modern software engineering practices (version control, testing, documentation, containerization)

• Conduct original, publishable scientific research generating novel insights at the intersection of AI and climate science

• Write and submit peer-reviewed journal papers, present at international conferences, and contribute to NCCR CLIM+ reporting and grant proposals

• Ensure that the research produces both scientific insight and methodological contributions to the field

• Collaborate closely with research groups at ETH (Prein, Knutti, Fischer) and UZH (Leippold, Vaghefi, Colesanti Senni) to align AI development with climate science research questions

• Participate in CLIM+ programme activities, workshops, and cross-project initiatives

• Contribute to supervision of students and interns where appropriate

Profile

• PhD in climate science, atmospheric science, computer science, data science, physics, applied mathematics, remote sensing, or a related field

• Strong publication record in AI, machine learning, or Earth system data science

• Experience with large geospatial datasets, remote sensing, reanalyses, or climate/weather model output

• Proficiency in Python and machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX

• Experience with HPC and GPU-accelerated computing

• Familiarity with foundation models / LLMs; interest in reproducible workflows

• Interest in reproducible workflows and scientific software development

• Independent, proactive, and collaborative working style with strong communication skills

Chercheur postdoctoral en AI pour l'Inférence sur l'information climatique

100%, Zurich, durée déterminée

imprimer
Drucken

Le chercheur postdoctoral fera progresser l'application de l'IA, des grands modèles linguistiques (LLM) et de l'apprentissage automatique afin d'extraire des informations fiables sur le climat à partir des ensembles de données géospatiales et des systèmes terrestres à grande échelle, dans le cadre du programme CLIM+ du CCNR. Le rôle est de relier la science du climat et l'IA, de développer de nouvelles méthodes d'analyse des données climatiques, de réduction de l'échelle et de synthèse à l'aide de modèles de base (p. ex. Google Earth AI, AlphaEarth, TerraTorch) sur une plate-forme HPC de pointe. Le chercheur effectuera des recherches scientifiques publiables tout en construisant des outils et des pipelines au service de la communauté CLIM+. Ce poste est supervisé conjointement par le Prof. Andreas Prein, le Prof. Erich Fischer et le Prof. Reto Knutti à l'ETH Zurich et le Prof. Markus Leippold à l'Université de Zurich.

Contexte du projet

La science du climat génère des volumes en croissance rapide de données satellitaires, de réanalyses et de modèles, créant de nouvelles possibilités mais aussi des défis majeurs pour transformer les données en informations solides et utiles. Ce projet mettra au point des méthodes basées sur l'IA pour extraire, synthétiser et interpréter des informations fiables sur le climat à partir d'ensembles de données de grands systèmes terrestres complexes dans le cadre du programme CLIM+ du CCNR.

Description du poste

• Concevoir, mettre au point et appliquer des méthodes d'IA/ML, y compris des modèles en langage large (LLM) et des modèles de fondation (Google Earth AI, AlphaEarth, TerraTorch), afin d'extraire, de synthétiser et de raisonner des informations fiables sur le climat à partir de séries de données géospatiales, satellitaires, de réanalyse et de modèles climatiques à grande échelle

• Apprentissage avancé en physique pour la représentation des processus climatiques à l'échelle du kilomètre

• Mettre en œuvre et évaluer des modèles d'IA génériques avancés pour la réduction du climat à haute résolution, l'assimilation des données, l'émulation et le post-traitement des prévisions météorologiques au climat

• Mettre au point des méthodes de quantification de l'incertitude dans les projections à échelle réduite des risques météorologiques et climatiques extrêmes

• Travailler avec les données du système terrestre multimodal, y compris les résultats des modèles climatiques à haute résolution, aériens, in situ et réanalyse;

• Mettre au point des logiciels et des pipelines de données robustes et évolutifs pour le traitement de grands ensembles de données géospatiales, ce qui permettra aux partenaires du projet CLIM+ et à l'ensemble de la communauté de la recherche de tirer parti des informations climatiques issues de l'IA

• Développer et maintenir des flux de travail de recherche reproductibles à l'aide de pratiques modernes de génie logiciel (contrôle des versions, essais, documentation, conteneurisation)

• Mener une recherche scientifique originale, publiable, générant de nouvelles idées à l'intersection de l'IA et des sciences du climat

• Rédiger et soumettre des articles de revues examinés par les pairs, présents lors de conférences internationales, et contribuer aux propositions de rapports et de subventions du CCNR CLIM+

• Veiller à ce que la recherche produise des connaissances scientifiques et des contributions méthodologiques sur le terrain

• Collaborer étroitement avec les groupes de recherche de l'ETH (Prein, Knutti, Fischer) et de l'UZH (Leippold, Vaghefi, Colesanti Senni) pour aligner le développement de l'IA sur les questions de recherche en sciences du climat

• Participer aux activités, ateliers et initiatives intersectorielles du programme CLIM+

• Contribuer à la supervision des étudiants et des stagiaires, le cas échéant

Profil

• Doctorat en sciences du climat, en sciences atmosphériques, en informatique, en sciences des données, en physique, en mathématiques appliquées, en télédétection ou dans un domaine connexe

• Forte publication dans l'IA, l'apprentissage automatique ou la science des données du système terrestre

descriptionByLocale.de: chevron_left Übersicht chevron_left Übersicht Fachspezialist:in Bewilligungen (m/w/d) 70%, Zürich, befristet print Drucken In der Abteilung Campus Services unterstützen wir Lehre, Forschung und Verwaltung in den Bereichen Logistik, Mobilität und Veranstaltungen. Wir stellen zudem ein umfassendes Informationsmanagement sowie die Orientierung an der ETH Zürich sicher und verantworten das Gastronomie- und Detailhandelsangebot. Für die Sektion Events und Partner Organisations suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine initiative und selbständig arbeitende Persönlichkeit als Fachspezialist:in Bewilligungen (m/w/d) in der Gruppe Eventsupport. Die Stelle ist vorerst auf 1 Jahr befristet. Stellenbeschreibung Was dich in dieser Rolle erwartet In dieser Funktion sorgst du dafür, dass Veranstaltungen und Aktivitäten auf allen ETH-Flächen und an allen Standorten korrekt, sorgfältig und lösungsorientiert bewilligt werden. Gleichzeitig behältst du auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen den Überblick. • Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Grundausbildung (mind. 3‑jährige Lehre) sowie mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung im administrativen Bereich • Strukturierte, zuverlässige und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägter Planungs‑ und Organisationsfähigkeit • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und die Fähigkeit, sich rasch in neue Themengebiete einzuarbeiten • Sehr gutes räumliches Vorstellungsvermögen sowie eine vernetzte und analytische Denkweise • Idealerweise Erfahrung im Projektmanagement • Hohe IT‑Affinität, sehr gute MS‑Office‑Kenntnisse und idealerweise Erfahrung mit CRM‑Systemen • Ausgeprägte Dienstleistungsorientierung, Kommunikationsstärke und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Anspruchsgruppen • Resilienz, Durchsetzungsvermögen und ausgeprägte Teamorientierung Arbeitsort Arbeitsort Wir bieten Dein Beruf mit Wirkung: Werde Teil der ETH Zürich, die nicht nur deine berufliche Entwicklung unterstützt, sondern auch aktiv zu positiven Veränderungen in der Gesellschaft beiträgt. descriptionByLocale.it: chevron ha lasciato Panoramica chevron ha lasciato Panoramica Specialista:in Autorizzazione (m/w/d) 70%, Zurigo, stampa limitata Nel dipartimento Servizi Campus, sosteniamo l'insegnamento, la ricerca e l'amministrazione nei settori della logistica, della mobilità e degli eventi. Garantiamo inoltre una gestione completa delle informazioni e un orientamento all'ETH di Zurigo e siamo responsabili dell'offerta gastronomica e di vendita al dettaglio. Per la sezione Eventi e Organizzazioni Partner, stiamo cercando un’iniziativa e una personalità autonoma come specialista: nelle approvazioni (m/w/d) del gruppo Eventsupport. Il posto è limitato a 1 anno prima. Cosa vi aspetta in questo ruolo In questa funzione, ti assicurerai che gli eventi e le attività siano approvati correttamente, accuratamente e orientati alla soluzione su tutte le aree ETH e in tutte le località. Si accompagnano richieste dall'inizio alla fine e sono una persona di contatto competente e affidabile per gli organizzatori. Assicurarsi che i requisiti siano rispettati – e allo stesso tempo stai cercando soluzioni pratiche nel campo dell'interesse, della fattibilità e della responsabilità. In particolare, questo significa: • Consulenza di clienti interni ed esterni su eventi e attività che tengano conto delle attuali esigenze e linee guida dell'ETH Zurigo • Autodeterminazione e valutazione delle richieste di autorizzazione per quanto riguarda la fattibilità, la fattibilità e i possibili impatti con particolare attenzione alla sicurezza, alla qualità e alla reputazione dell'ETH • Preparazione delle decisioni di autorizzazione, chiara comunicazione delle decisioni e verifica del rispetto delle condizioni concesse; • Supporto per altre aree di competenza all'interno del gruppo Allo stesso tempo, si mantiene anche una panoramica in situazioni difficili. • Formazione commerciale di base completa (min. 3 anni di apprendistato) e diversi anni di esperienza professionale amministrativa • Funzionamento strutturato, affidabile e auto-responsabile con una chiara capacità di pianificazione e di organizzazione • Concepimento rapido e la capacità di lavorare rapidamente in nuovi argomenti • Ottima immaginazione spaziale e un modo di pensare collegato e analitico • Esperienza ideale nella gestione del progetto • Alta capacità IT-Affinity, ottime competenze di MS-Office e la comunicazione idealmente Offriamo la vostra professione con effetto: Fa parte dell'ETH di Zurigo, che non solo supporta il vostro sviluppo professionale, ma contribuisce attivamente ai cambiamenti positivi nella società. Lavorare al Vice-Presidium for Infrastructure and Sustainability (VPIN) significa plasmare attivamente il futuro dell'ETH Zurigo - un'istituzione ispiratrice, internazionale e innovativa. Il vostro impegno crea le migliori condizioni per l'eccellenza nell'insegnamento, nella ricerca, nel trasferimento di conoscenze e nella sostenibilità dell'ETH Zurigo. In un'atmosfera aperta e stimolante, fiducia, affidabilità e rispetto reciproco costituiscono la base della nostra cooperazione. Vi offriamo non solo la sicurezza, ma anche una vasta gamma di possibilità per un ulteriore sviluppo. Ci aspettiamo che lavori in modo significativo
descriptionByLocale.en: chevron left Overview chevron left Overview Specialist:in Authorizations (m/w/d) 70%, Zurich, limited print Print In the Campus Services department, we support teaching, research and administration in the fields of logistics, mobility and events. We also ensure comprehensive information management as well as orientation at ETH Zurich and are responsible for the gastronomy and retail offer. For the Events and Partner Organisations section, we are looking for an initiative and self-employed personality as a specialist:in approvals (m/w/d) in the Eventsupport group. The place is limited to 1 year earlier. What awaits you in this role In this function, you will ensure that events and activities are approved correctly, carefully and solution-oriented on all ETH areas and at all locations. You accompany enquiries from the beginning to the end and are a competent, reliable contact person for organizers. You make sure that requirements are complied with – and at the same time you are looking for practical solutions in the field of interest, feasibility and responsibility. Specifically, this means: • Advising internal and external clients on events and activities taking into account the current requirements and guidelines of ETH Zurich • Self-determination and assessment of authorisation requests with regard to feasibility, feasibility and possible impacts with a particular focus on the security, quality and reputation of ETH • Preparation of authorisation decisions, clear communication of decisions and verification of compliance with the conditions granted; • Support for other areas of expertise within the group as well as group-wide, if required Profile You like to work structured, take responsibility and feel comfortable in a service-oriented environment. At the same time, you also keep an overview in challenging situations. • Complete basic commercial training (min. 3 years of apprenticeship) and several years of administrative professional experience • Structured, reliable and self-responsive working with a pronounced planning and organisational capability • Quick conception and the ability to work quickly into new topics • Very good spatial imagination as well as a connected and analytical way of thinking • Ideally experience in project management • High IT-Affinity, very good MS-Office skills and ideally experience with CRM systems • Embossed service orientation, communication strength and joy in cooperation with different stakeholders • Resilience, enforcement ability and strong team orientation We offer your profession with effect: Be part of ETH Zurich, which not only supports your professional development, but also actively contributes to positive changes in society. Working at the Vice-Presidium for Infrastructure and Sustainability (VPIN) means actively shaping the future of ETH Zurich - an inspiring, international and innovative institution. Your commitment creates the best conditions for excellence in teaching, research, knowledge transfer and sustainability at ETH Zurich. In an open, inspiring atmosphere, trust, reliability and mutual respect form the foundation of our cooperation. We offer you not only safety, but also a wide range of possibilities for further development. We expect you to work in a meaningful way

Pour la section Événements et organisations partenaires, nous recherchons une initiative et une personnalité indépendante en tant que spécialiste: dans les approbations (m/w/d) dans le groupe Eventsupport. Travailler au vice-présidium pour l'infrastructure et la durabilité (VPIN) signifie façonner activement l'avenir de l'ETH Zurich - une institution inspirante, internationale et innovante. Votre engagement crée les meilleures conditions d'excellence dans l'enseignement, la recherche, le transfert de connaissances et la durabilité à l'ETH Zurich. Dans une atmosphère ouverte et inspirante, la confiance, la fiabilité et le respect mutuel forment le fondement de notre coopération. Nous vous offrons non seulement la sécurité, mais aussi un large éventail de possibilités de développement. Nous espérons que vous travaillerez de manière significative
